description:
Team Name: The Martians
We are The Martians, a team passionate about innovation and space exploration. Our project, MARS-WALK, integrates NASA's Mars mission data into an interactive platform to help users explore Martian terrain, visualize routes, identify potential hazards, and understand scientific discoveries. Our goal is to support safer, smarter, and more efficient future human exploration of Mars.
summary:
MARSWALK is an intelligent Mars mission-planning platform designed to support safer, smarter, and more efficient human exploration of the Red Planet. Inspired by NASA’s Mars exploration missions, the project integrates planetary terrain data, orbital imagery, rover observations, environmental information, and scientific discoveries into one interactive platform.

The system features an interactive Mars map, GIS data layers, terrain and hazard analysis, environmental telemetry, and science-target detection. Its intelligent route planner compares three different mission paths: Route A (Shortest Route), Route B (Safest Route), and Route C (Science-Optimized Route). Each route is evaluated using factors such as distance, elevation, terrain difficulty, hazard exposure, and scientific value.

MARSWALK also includes an AI-powered mission assistance interface that explains route recommendations and helps users understand potential risks and scientific opportunities. By combining information from multiple Mars exploration missions, the platform aims to transform complex planetary data into meaningful insights for future astronaut missions.

Our core vision is simple: on Mars, the shortest route isn't always the best route.

**MARSWALK — Plan the Walk. Discover the Unknown.**
details:
MARSWALK – Intelligent Mars Mission Planning System

MARSWALK is an interactive Mars mission-planning platform designed to help astronauts and mission planners explore the Martian surface and make smarter decisions when navigating across Mars. The project focuses on solving an important challenge in Mars exploration: choosing the most suitable route by considering not only distance but also safety, scientific opportunities, and environmental hazards.

The platform features an interactive Mars map where users can explore different locations, identify potential hazards, and compare multiple mission routes. It offers three route-planning options: Route A – Shortest Route, which prioritizes minimum travel distance; Route B – Safest Route, which focuses on avoiding dangerous terrain and potential hazards; and Route C – Science-Optimized Route, which prioritizes scientifically valuable locations and exploration opportunities.

MARSWALK also includes an AI-powered mission assistance feature to support decision-making and a mission scoring system to evaluate route performance based on different mission objectives.

Benefits and Intended Impact:

MARSWALK aims to make Mars exploration planning more efficient, safer, and scientifically productive. By comparing different routes and mission priorities, it helps users understand the trade-offs between travel distance, astronaut safety, and scientific value. The platform demonstrates how intelligent route planning can contribute to future robotic and human exploration missions on Mars.

Tools and Technologies:

The project was developed using modern web technologies and AI-assisted development tools. We used Antigravity as our development environment, along with web-based technologies to build the interactive interface, Mars map, route comparison system, hazard visualization, and AI mission assistance features.

Creativity and Innovation:

The creative aspect of MARSWALK is its multi-objective approach to Mars navigation. Instead of simply finding the shortest path, it allows users to compare routes based on different exploration goals. This makes mission planning more interactive, educational, and realistic.

Factors Considered by Our Team:

Our team, The Martians, considered several important factors while developing MARSWALK, including terrain safety, potential surface hazards, travel distance, scientific research opportunities, mission efficiency, and the balance between exploration goals and astronaut safety.

Our core philosophy is simple: "The shortest route isn't always the best route." MARSWALK turns this idea into an interactive mission-planning experience for the future of Mars exploration.
